gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2014, Syndicate 2987 reported a net aggregate release of GBP 8.7 million from its prior year claims reserves, representing a 1.34% release relative to the opening gross reserves. This favorable development was driven by the claims experience over prior years. The Brit Global Specialty Direct portfolio experienced a strengthening of GBP 0.9 million, while the RI portfolio saw a release of GBP 7.0 million and Other Underwriting a release of GBP 2.6 million. The syndicate also purchased a specific one-off reinsurance contract for GBP 42.9 million to cover adverse development on a discontinued professional lines account with exposure to Italian medical malpractice, transferring GBP 40.3 million of reserves to the reinsurer to gain greater certainty over this legacy account. During the year, the syndicate sustained some losses from natural catastrophes like Hurricane Odile and man-made events such as the Tripoli airport attack, but the overall claims environment was benign.
